description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and classes for managing F1AP connection procedures between a gNB-DU and a CU-CP in a 5G network, including setup, reset, configuration updates, and interface management.

classes.name: f1ap_connection_manager
classes.description: Abstract interface for managing F1AP connection procedures between DU and CU-CP, including setup, removal, reset, and configuration updates.

classes.name: f1ap_interface_update_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the DU of CU-initiated interface management requests via F1AP.

methods.name: connect_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Establishes connection to CU-CP via F1-C interface.

methods.name: disconnect_from_cu_cp
methods.description: Disconnects the DU from CU-CP after a failed F1 setup.

methods.name: handle_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Handles the F1 setup request procedure, initiating setup and awaiting response.

methods.name: is_f1_setup
methods.description: Checks if the F1 interface has been set up with the CU-CP.

methods.name: request_cu_context_update
methods.description: Notifies the DU of a CU-initiated configuration update request.
